method: Restart from the frozen family definition, printed CSZ definitions of seeded precoloring/Q/Lemma10, the sealed P7 Lemma5/6/7/10 transfer, and the external wall mim-width theorems. Do not import the primary result's conclusion.

original_axioms: S={s1,s2} is connected and no outside vertex is complete to S.
Exactly m,w,Z_n are anticomplete to S, so axiom (iii) gives Y0={m,w} union Z_n.
Y0 is stable, so axiom (iv) is vacuous.
Seed-neighborhood colors give exactly the claimed 3-lists and 4-lists, so axiom (v) holds.
The declared extension is proper for every n.
Q_replay: Only the two relevant singleton-color source types are T={s1} and T'={s2}.
For both ordered pairs, the 111 triples p-m-n0 / n0-m-p satisfy P subset Y(type), M subset Y0, N subset Y(type'), M complete to P union N, and P anticomplete to N.
For a 111 triple the source definition gives Z(T,T')=empty.
Colors p=3,n0=4 lie outside source colors {1,2}; f union f_Q is proper.
Hence the frozen Q is admissible and produces the post-Q seed {s1,s2,p,m,n0}.
The sealed P7 Lemma10-transfer applies; canonical repartition leaves wall/a1/a2/r as 3-list Y and w,Z_n as 4-list Y0.
seed_two_replay: Add a1=1 and a2=3 to the seed.
Only w among post-Q Y0 sees the selected vertices, so residual Y0 is exactly Z_n.
w has list {2,4} and becomes X; wall vertices remain list {2,3,4}; r remains list {1,3,4}.
Thus final Y cap N(Y0) has at least two list classes, so the state is not dismissed by axiom (vi).
sigma_replay: Every wall survivor has final list {2,3,4}.
Every wall survivor has the same old post-Q seed type {s1}.
Every wall survivor has witness mask {2}.
Every wall survivor is anticomplete to stored support {p,m,n0}.
Every wall survivor belongs to source Z(L') via nonadjacency to a2 with selected color 3 in L'.
incidence_replay: Every residual Y0 component is singleton {z_e}.
For wall survivor v, incidence to {z_e} is exactly endpoint incidence in W_n.
Therefore I_sigma is exactly the all-edge 1-subdivision J_n.
P7_replay: Each z_e is simplicial: ordinary neighborhood {a,b} is a clique; special neighborhood {a,b,r} is a clique.
Hence Z_n appears only at induced-path endpoints.
In R=G-Z_n, A_n, B_n, and {a1,a2} are independent false-twin classes; any induced path with >=4 vertices contains at most one vertex from each such class.
The fixed role graph has no induced P7; its only induced P6 role patterns up to reversal are p-m-n0-s2-alpha-w, p-m-r-s2-alpha-w, and m-p-s1-s2-alpha-w.
No P6 role path has an endpoint in D={A,B,r}, and no P5 role path has both endpoints in D.
0/1/2 subdivision-endpoint cases therefore exclude every induced P7 in the full family.
width_replay: IPEC 2020 Lemma 2 gives mimw(G)<=mimw(G') for a one-edge 1-subdivision.
Sequentially subdividing all wall edges yields mimw(J_n)>=mimw(W_n)>=sqrt(n)/50.

limitations: This falsifies only the universal bounded-mim common-layout route.
It does not falsify narrower source-subclass routers or non-mim composition mechanisms.
It does not prove the full L2 repair impossible.
It does not prove or disprove P=NP.
